findings.evidence: Basic.lean:427-445 `private theorem ofConv_mul_apply ... (LinearMap.mul' k (ConvolutionDual k H) w).ofConv x = dualDistribEquiv k H w (Coalgebra.comul x)` under `[HopfAlgebra k H]` (line 411); Functoriality.lean:234-245 `private theorem convMul_apply_eq_dualDistribEquiv ... (phi * psi).ofConv x = dualDistribEquiv k H (phi ⊗ₜ[k] psi) (Coalgebra.comul x)` under `[Bialgebra k H]` (line 177), with an identical `induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on` proof; Functoriality.lean:215-224 repeats the same induction inline.
findings.fix: Move the fact into the Coalgebra/Bialgebra section of `Basic.lean` as a public lemma, e.g. `@[grind =] theorem convMul_apply (phi psi : ConvolutionDual k H) (x : H) : (phi * psi).ofConv x = dualDistribEquiv k H (phi ⊗ₜ[k] psi) (Coalgebra.comul x)` (keeping the general-`w` form `ofConv_mul_apply` public alongside it if the antipode proofs still need it), delete `convMul_apply_eq_dualDistribEquiv`, and use the public lemma at Functoriality.lean:215-224 and Basic.lean:497/508.
findings.issue: `convMul_apply_eq_dualDistribEquiv` duplicates `ofConv_mul_apply` (Basic.lean:427), which states the same fact for a general tensor `w`. The Basic version is `private` and sits under `variable ... [HopfAlgebra k H]` (Basic.lean:411) even though its proof needs only the coalgebra/algebra structure, so this file cannot reuse it and re-derives it; the same identity is inlined a third time inside `evalAlgHom.map_mul'` (Functoriality.lean:215-224). The multiplication on `ConvolutionDual` therefore has no public characteristic lemma matching the public `dualDistribEquiv_comul_apply` for comultiplication.

summary: The exposed surface is minimal, bodies are hidden, and map/mapEquiv/evalBialgEquiv each have complete pointwise characterizations with sane simp annotations. But the characteristic lemma for the convolution product on ConvolutionDual is missing from the public API of Basic.lean, so Functoriality.lean re-proves it twice.
